Carbon KEO Track Pedals with Straps, compatible with Keo pedal systems our own brand sealed bearing pedals are widely used by professional Track Cyclists due to the Keo compatibility and straps that offer a quick, easy and secure toe strap solutions.
Contains-
Pedals

Keo Carbon Compatible Pedals
Durable cartridge type sealed bearings for reliable, durable performance.
Fully Adjustable release tension.
Keo Compatible floating cleats.

Includes

Track Cycling Sprint Straps

Engineered for Maximum Pedal Security, the Velodrome.Shop Track Cycling Sprint Straps are built for riders who want a more secure, more direct connection to the pedal during the hardest efforts on the track.

Developed around a proven low-profile sprint strap layout, they are designed to deliver firm foot retention under load without the bulk, movement or vague feel of older, more traditional strap systems. The aim is simple: keep the foot more stable, more planted and more confident when the torque rises.

In standing starts, gate efforts, match sprint accelerations and heavy training work, small amounts of foot movement can immediately reduce confidence in the pedal interface. These straps are designed to minimise that movement and provide a locked-in feel when every part of the effort has to transfer cleanly.

name: Shimano Dura-Ace SPD-SL Track Pedals with Straps
description:
The perfect pedal system for Track Sprinters - Shimano Dura Ace SPD-SL Pedals and the Track Sprint Straps

Shimano Dura Ace SPD-SL Pedals a super lightweight carbon SPD-SL road pedal for high performance road racing

Lightweight carbon body provides large shoe contact area to maximise power transfer and support whilst reducing weight

The wide flat profile gives better road clearance and cornering, also allowing wider bearing placement for increased rigidity and uniform load distribution

Low profile 8.8 mm body height from axle centre to cleat contact surface

Silky smooth 3-bearing axle system, two ball- and one wide roller-bearing

Stainless steel pedal body plate for increased durability

Open design allows for easy access and cleat adjustments

Wider shoe cleat has a long life and is easier for walking than other cleats

Large binding target allows quick engagement while wide cleats provides more efficient pedalling

Pedals supplied with SM-SH12 blue 2 degree front centre pivoting cleats

Three types of replacement shoe cleats available: SM-SH10 red cleat fixed position, SM-SH12 blue cleat 2 degrees of float in front centre pivot, or SM-SH11 yellow cleat 6 degrees of float overall side to side

Weight: 228 grams per pair
